{{Quote|The Empire's internal military police force keeps order within the ranks as needed, though our troops are so well-disciplined that such action is rarely required.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Military Police''' was a branch of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|armed forces]] which were charged with ensuring that members of the military acted within the laws established by the Empire.<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>
